question: In October 2024, Partha Sengupta was appointed as the MD and CEO of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bandhan Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Partha Sengupta was appointed as the MD and CEO of **Bandhan Bank** in October 2024.
 
• Bandhan Bank is a major Indian commercial bank with its headquarters located in Kolkata, West Bengal.
 
• The bank was established in 2015 and primarily focuses on serving the unbanked and underbanked segments of the population.
 
• Partha Sengupta's appointment follows his extensive experience in the banking sector, contributing to the bank's growth and operational efficiency.
 
• Bandhan Bank operates a network of over 1000 branches across India, providing a range of financial services including retail banking, loans, and microfinance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Banking Sector in India**

 
 
• India's banking sector is governed by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), which is responsible for regulating and supervising financial institutions.
 
• Commercial banks in India are categorized into public sector banks, private sector banks, foreign banks, and regional rural banks.
 
• The sector has witnessed significant reforms in recent years, focusing on financial inclusion, digital banking, and asset quality improvement.
 
• Technological advancements such as mobile banking, internet banking, and Unified Payments Interface (UPI) have revolutionized banking services in India.
 
 
 
• **Bandhan Bank**
 
 
• Founded in 2015, Bandhan Bank emerged from a microfinance institution, Bandhan Financial Services Limited.
 
• The bank's mission is to bring banking services to the underprivileged and unbanked populations in India.
 
• Bandhan Bank received its banking license from the Reserve Bank of India in June 2015 and commenced operations in August 2015.
 
• It offers a wide range of banking products including savings and current accounts, fixed deposits, loans, insurance, and microfinance.
 
 
 
• **Partha Sengupta**
 
 
• Partha Sengupta has had a distinguished career in the banking and finance sector, with leadership roles in various financial institutions.
 
• Prior to joining Bandhan Bank, he held key positions in notable banks, contributing to strategic planning and operational excellence.
 
• His expertise includes areas such as retail banking, corporate banking, risk management, and digital banking innovations.
 
• His leadership is expected to drive Bandhan Bank's expansion and enhance its service offerings to cater to a broader customer base.
